description: A taxon in NCBI Taxonomy or a strain-level genome record from BV-BRC. Coverage includes selected bacteria, viruses and human-infecting pathogens, their taxonomic ancestors, Homo sapiens and SARS-CoV-2, together with BV-BRC genomes and their parent lineages. Taxa and genome-level strains share this node type and are distinguished by their identifiers and ranks. Some organisms also identify a representative strain supplying their protein data.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: NCBI Taxonomy identifier (NCBITaxon:{taxid}) for taxa, or BV-BRC genome identifier (BVBRC:{genome_id}) for strain-level genome records.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Accepted scientific name from NCBI Taxonomy, or the genome name supplied by BV-BRC.

common_properties.name: rank
common_properties.description: Taxonomic rank from NCBI Taxonomy, including ranks such as species, genus and no rank. BV-BRC genome records have rank strain.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution for the organism: ncbitaxa for NCBI Taxonomy taxa and BV-BRC for genome-level strains.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of organism creation or changes to its descriptive properties. Changes to representative_strain are not reflected in this timestamp.

source_contributions.scope: Taxa selected from bacteria in KEGG; viruses in PathoPhenoDB; viruses and Homo sapiens in VirHost; and pathogens in human-host PHI-base records. Homo sapiens and SARS-CoV-2 are included unconditionally. Taxonomic ancestors and lineages supporting qualifying BV-BRC strains are included. The NCBI root (taxid 1) is excluded. These selection resources determine coverage; taxon names, ranks and common names come from NCBI Taxonomy.
source_contributions.description: Provides accepted scientific names, taxonomic ranks and optional common names. Taxa added to support BV-BRC strains outside the primary selection can retain the name, rank and common name from their initial taxonomy snapshot.

properties.name: common_name
properties.description: Common name from NCBI Taxonomy, when available.

source_contributions.scope: Non-deprecated genome assemblies with a taxon ID and at least one available annotation among antimicrobial resistance, pathovar, gram stain, cell shape, motility, sporulation, temperature range, salinity, oxygen requirement, host name or AMR phenotype availability. Taxonomically unresolvable records are excluded; qualifying genomes can be accompanied by additional NCBI parent lineages. Cell shape affects this inclusion scope but is not a node property.
source_contributions.description: Each strain-level node represents a sequenced genome assembly with optional phenotypic, isolation and host metadata. BV-BRC identifiers retain the reported genome ID even if its leading taxon number is an old merged NCBI ID. AMR phenotype availability is recorded separately from resistance annotations; individual AMR tests and measurements are not included in these node properties. Empty annotations are omitted.

properties.name: strain
properties.description: Source-reported strain designation.

properties.name: serovar
properties.description: Source-reported serovar annotation.

properties.name: biovar
properties.description: Source-reported biovar annotation.

properties.name: pathovar
properties.description: Source-reported pathovar annotation.

properties.name: gram_stain
properties.description: Gram-stain annotation, with recognized positive and negative values represented as Positive and Negative. Other nonempty annotations can retain source values.

properties.name: motility
properties.description: Motility annotation, with recognized values represented as Yes or No; weak or gliding motility is represented as Yes. Other nonempty annotations can retain source values.

properties.name: sporulation
properties.description: Sporulation annotation, with recognized values represented as Yes or No. Other nonempty annotations can retain source values.

properties.name: oxygen_requirement
properties.description: Source-reported oxygen requirement, without normalization.

properties.name: temperature_range
properties.description: Source-reported temperature-range annotation.

properties.name: salinity
properties.description: Source-reported salinity annotation.

properties.name: host_name
properties.description: Host name supplied by BV-BRC.

properties.name: host_gender
properties.description: Host-gender annotation supplied by BV-BRC.

properties.name: host_age
properties.description: Host-age annotation supplied by BV-BRC.

properties.name: host_health
properties.description: Host-health annotation supplied by BV-BRC.

properties.name: disease
properties.description: Free-text disease annotation supplied by BV-BRC.

properties.name: isolation_source
properties.description: Source-reported isolation-source annotation.

properties.name: isolation_country
properties.description: Source-reported country of isolation; a value may also contain a sub-region after a colon.

properties.name: collection_date
properties.description: Collection date as a string preserving the source format.

properties.name: genome_size
properties.description: Genome length supplied by BV-BRC as genome_length, stored as a string.

properties.name: usa_isolation_country
properties.description: Yes when isolation_country equals usa, ignoring case; absent otherwise.

properties.name: host_is_human
properties.description: Yes when host_name contains homo sapiens, homo-sapiens, human or homosapiens, ignoring case; absent otherwise.

properties.name: is_resistant
properties.description: Yes for resistance annotations including Resistant, Intermediate, Non-susceptible and Susceptible-dose dependent, and for other unrecognized nonempty annotations. Absent for empty or Not defined annotations and for Susceptible alone. This flag therefore includes possible resistance rather than confirmed resistance alone.

properties.name: has_amr_phenotype
properties.description: Yes when the genome has at least one entry in the BV-BRC AMR phenotype file; absent otherwise. Indicates data availability, rather than a resistance result.

properties.name: genbank_accessions
properties.description: GenBank accessions reported for the genome, represented as separate entries from the comma-delimited source field.

properties.name: antimicrobial_resistance
properties.description: Antimicrobial-resistance annotations supplied by BV-BRC, represented as separate entries from the semicolon-delimited source field.

source_contributions.scope: Organisms whose protein data comes from a representative taxonomic subclass because they have no direct Swiss-Prot proteins.
source_contributions.description: The representative_strain annotation identifies the subclass supplying the organism’s protein data. The representative is the candidate subclass containing the single longest individual protein sequence; proteins from other candidate subclasses are not represented for that organism.

properties.name: representative_strain
properties.description: NCBI Taxonomy CURIE of the selected representative subclass. Its presence means that proteins assigned to this organism come from that subclass rather than direct Swiss-Prot data for the organism itself.
